correctness.rationale: Direct differentiation gives partial_p eta=-rho/((gamma-1)p)<0, so every rectangle minimizer lies on p=p_+. Along that edge, partial_rho eta=(gamma+gamma log rho-log p-C)/(gamma-1) has the unique zero r_C=exp(-1+C/gamma)p_+^(1/gamma), and strict convexity gives the clamped minimizer. A fresh symbolic Hessian calculation gives determinant 1/((gamma-1)p^2)>0. Equating the two endpoint entropies yields the identric mean threshold and the stated gauge-flip constant. The deposited script numerically reproduces the counterexample and excess identity; these numbers are supporting evidence only.
